_comment: The planet editor's parameter catalogue (plan §5.1, §7.12 setup page): one list for the game's Create World editor (screen/model/EditorFields reads it from the jar as deeptime/editor_fields.json; Gradle copies it like ramps.json) and the browser workbench (deeptime watch, P1-20). Each field names the preset JSON path it edits; a field is editable exactly when the selected preset carries that path, so neither side adds keys a preset does not know. Labels are the lang keys deeptime.editor.field.<id> and deeptime.editor.section.<section> (neoforge/src/main/resources/assets/deeptime/lang/en_us.json). kind: number | toggle | choice; integer numbers are written as JSON integers (the seed is a u64), other numbers as doubles; phase3 marks a fantasy toggle shown disabled until Phase 3; planned marks a setting whose stage or preset key does not exist yet (its path is a proposal): it shows as not in the preset, and the real built-ins need not carry it (ModelHelpersTest.realPresetsCarryEveryField). The planet, scale and seed paths and ranges are P1-03's params.rs (PlanetParams, ScaleParams, PlanetPreset::validate); the others are proposals for stages that have not landed (their ranges are the editor's sanity bounds; the core validates in the end). hint is a one-line description of a field and sections a one-line description of each section: the workbench shows both under the controls; the game's EditorFields ignores them for now.

sections.planet: The world itself: its seed, gravity, day, tilt, sunlight and oceans.
sections.scale: How much real planet one block stands for, across and up.
sections.multipliers: Scale deposits and terrain features up or down, relative to the preset.
sections.fantasy: Terrain beyond geology. It arrives in Phase 3, so these stay off for now.
sections.playability: Guarantees that make a world playable, whatever its history.

fields.hint: Seeds the whole history: the same seed and settings always make the same planet.
Surface gravity. Earth: 9.81 m/s².
Hours in one rotation. Earth: 24 h.
Tilt of the spin axis, which sets the seasons and climate belts. Earth: 23.4°.
Sunlight reaching the planet, relative to Earth's.
Share of the surface under the sea. Earth: about 0.71.
Metres of planet per block, east–west and north–south.
Metres of planet per block, up and down: smaller values make taller terrain.
How many ore deposits form, relative to the preset.
How large each deposit grows, relative to the preset.
How rich the ore is, relative to the preset.
How strongly deposits cluster into ore provinces: 0 spreads them evenly.
Size of deposit bodies in blocks.
Width of rivers in blocks.
Size of canyons in blocks.
Thickness of rock layers in blocks.
Steepness of slopes and the strength of fine terrain detail. 1 is as simulated.
Magical ore fields and landforms beyond geology.
Floating islands above the terrain.
Landforms no real planet makes.
The materials every region is guaranteed, from the pack's essentials list.
